title: Exploring the Utility of [18F]3F4AP for Demyelination Imaging
official: Exploring the Utility of [18F]3F4AP for Demyelination Imaging
summary: The overall objective is to obtain an assessment of the pharmacokinetics of \[18F\]3F4AP in healthy volunteers and subjects with demyelinating diseases such as mild cognitive impairment (MCI), Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) and Spinal radiculopathy (SR).
